findings.evidenceJa: 主の異状を察して
findings.governingReading: I sensed something abnormal with my Master
findings.explanation: Archer’s claimed detection of Rin’s abnormal condition is strengthened into certain danger.

findings.evidenceJa: そこに直れっていうの
findings.governingReading: Sit yourself down right there while I tell you from the beginning
findings.explanation: Rin’s comic disciplinary order to present himself for a scolding becomes generic attention.

findings.evidenceJa: やんわりと受け流している
findings.governingReading: gently parrying everything she says
findings.explanation: Archer’s soft handling of Rin’s anger becomes neutral calm dismissal.

findings.evidenceJa: 仲がいい
findings.governingReading: get along well / have a close relationship
findings.explanation: Saber’s observation of their underlying rapport is strengthened toward romantic or physical intimacy.

findings.evidenceJa: 難しい顔
findings.governingReading: a troubled, complicated expression
findings.explanation: The English copies the Japanese collocation into unnatural English.

findings.evidenceJa: 体裁など気にしない
findings.governingReading: I will not concern myself with appearances or propriety
findings.explanation: Archer’s social posture becomes aesthetic style.

findings.highlight: Let’s say it’s good for now
findings.evidenceJa: 今回の件は分けという事にしておこう
findings.governingReading: Let us call this matter even / a draw
findings.explanation: Archer’s proposed settlement is rendered as vague temporary acceptability.

findings.highlight: he looks like a cold warrior
findings.evidenceJa: 冷徹な戦士の趣
findings.governingReading: the bearing of a cold, ruthless warrior
findings.explanation: A sudden change in Archer’s demeanor becomes an external resemblance.

findings.evidenceJa: 腑抜けめ
findings.governingReading: You spineless weakling
findings.explanation: Archer attacks Rider’s lack of fighting spirit, not her intelligence.

findings.evidenceJa: 勝ち抜ける器ではない
findings.governingReading: lacked the caliber to fight through to victory
findings.explanation: Archer’s assessment of Rider’s fundamental caliber is flattened.

findings.highlight: show some spirit to at least kill your enemy as well
findings.evidenceJa: 敵と相打つぐらいの気迫は見せろ
findings.governingReading: show enough resolve at least to take your enemy down with you
findings.explanation: The mutual-death standard Archer imposes is reduced to killing an enemy.

findings.highlight: she should be ashamed that she could not even defeat a single enemy
findings.evidenceJa: 最低限一人は殺さなければ面目が立つまい
findings.governingReading: she cannot save face unless she kills at least one enemy
findings.explanation: External heroic honor and a minimum kill requirement become personal shame over defeat.

findings.evidenceJa: 勝手な事を
findings.governingReading: What a self-serving thing to say
findings.explanation: Saber condemns Archer’s arbitrary judgment; “convenient” obscures the target.

findings.evidenceJa: その散り様を罵る
findings.governingReading: to revile the manner of her death
findings.explanation: Saber’s objection to insulting Rider’s final death is weakened to discussing defeat.

findings.evidenceJa: 無様に破れた
findings.governingReading: defeated disgracefully
findings.explanation: Archer’s contemptuous moral evaluation becomes vague performance quality.

findings.highlight: is it your way of the knight
findings.evidenceJa: 君の騎士道なのか
findings.governingReading: is that your code of chivalry
findings.explanation: Archer’s pointed appeal to Saber’s knightly ethics becomes malformed English.

findings.evidenceJa: 静かな一喝
findings.governingReading: Rin’s quiet but sharp rebuke
findings.explanation: The force with which Rin stops both Servants disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: マスターも一人脱落した
findings.governingReading: one Master has also been eliminated from the contest
findings.explanation: The formal status change is generalized into physical absence.

findings.evidenceJa: あまりにも王道ゆえ
findings.governingReading: so impeccably orthodox and knightly
findings.explanation: Archer’s wordplay on Saber’s straight royal path is flattened.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka moves Archer back as well.
findings.evidenceJa: とにかく、と場をしきり直す
findings.governingReading: Rin moves Archer behind her and, with a decisive “anyway,” resets the discussion
findings.explanation: Rin’s active control of the meeting and tonal reset disappear.

findings.highlight: We should let them be and keep them off guard
findings.evidenceJa: 今はそれを続けさせた方がいい
findings.governingReading: For now, it is better to let the Master continue coming to school
findings.explanation: The concrete surveillance plan becomes a broad claim about keeping the enemy off guard.

findings.highlight: coming to school every day defenselessly
findings.evidenceJa: 無防備なままで学校に来ている
findings.governingReading: continues coming to school without protection
findings.explanation: The lack of Caster’s defended territory is recast as a globally defenseless person.

findings.highlight: how good the Servant is at magic
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術に長けたサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: a Servant so skilled in magecraft
findings.explanation: The technical category is again generalized to magic.

findings.evidenceJa: そんな間の抜けた話
findings.governingReading: such an absurdly inept situation
findings.explanation: The contradiction in circumstances becomes generic stupidity.

findings.highlight: She would first control her Master to do whatever she wishes.
findings.evidenceJa: マスターなど最初の一手で排除し、都合のいいように扱う
findings.governingReading: She would remove the Master as an independent obstacle with her first move, then handle him however suited her
findings.explanation: Archer’s two-stage claim—neutralize the Master first, then exploit him—collapses into simple control.

findings.highlight: Either by trickery or removing the memory of being a Master?
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターに騙されているか、自分がマスターだって忘れさせられてるとか
findings.governingReading: Either Caster has deceived him, or made him forget that he is a Master
findings.explanation: Rin’s two explicit hypotheses become a subjectless fragment.

findings.highlight: cannot do something to its Master
findings.evidenceJa: マスターには手出しができない
findings.governingReading: cannot lay a hand on its Master
findings.explanation: A specific prohibition or practical inability to attack is rendered as nearly meaningless.

findings.highlight: trick your Master than to kill him
findings.evidenceJa: 騙す方が安全だ
findings.governingReading: deceive the Master rather than eliminate him
findings.explanation: The English adds a male gender not supplied by the current hypothesis.

findings.highlight: if Caster gets control of you again
findings.evidenceJa: またキャスターなんかに連れ出されたりしたら
findings.governingReading: if you let Caster lure you out again
findings.explanation: The repeated danger is the concrete abduction sequence, not an established renewal of total control.

findings.highlight: You’re acting just a bit like a Master now.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方をマスターだって認めてあげた
findings.governingReading: I have acknowledged you as a Master, just a little
findings.explanation: Rin’s reluctant change in judgment becomes a comment on temporary behavior.

findings.evidenceJa: さっきの不始末
findings.governingReading: that mess / misconduct of yours earlier
findings.explanation: Rin’s promised accounting for Archer’s serious conduct is weakened to carelessness.

findings.evidenceJa: 口汚さが足りない
findings.governingReading: that your language was not nearly abusive enough
findings.explanation: Archer’s joke about Rin’s unusually restrained insults becomes a nonstandard adjective.

findings.evidenceJa: 心身ともに休憩を入れよう
findings.governingReading: give both body and mind a rest
findings.explanation: The planned recovery’s explicit physical and psychological scope disappears.
